facts.fact: GuiM says NimbaPay, the national instant payment system, was launched on 22 July 2026 under the leadership of the Central Bank of Guinea, with GuiM, whose board includes the central bank, operating the national payment switch.

GIN.note: Document states nothing on consumer protection.
Cross-border payments are only a planned later phase.
Payments to public administrations are a planned phase and not payments to people.
Document names no law or rules.
Document gives no account-ownership survey figure.

facts.fact: GuiM says NimbaPay, launched 22 July 2026, gives instant interoperable transfers between accounts across participating banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions.
GuiM, whose mission is to operate the national payment switch, says NimbaPay is the national instant payment system connecting banks and e-money institutions from its launch on 22 July 2026.

GIN.note: Document states nothing on tax or fee payment.
